text:
alejandra_sales: HS Venture wants a 30-day air-gapped POC. They asked for USB delivery, signed bundles, SBOM, HSM verification, delta updates on slow links, 30-day offline activation and emergency hotfix path. Need a short feasibility blurb + PS hours.

tom_se: short answer: feasible with constraints. Can we confirm bundle sizes and delta limits?

rachael_ops: notes: full bundle ~2.2GB (depends on model artifacts). We support intra-minor deltas only (e.g., 4.0.x -> 4.0.y). Transfers use resumable 64MB chunks.

omar_security: security points: we provide SPDX v2.2 SBOMs and an offline verifier utility. Customers can import a public key exported from their HSM for local verification; we do not accept customer private keys in our build pipeline. Add SOW clause for key rotation and emergency revocation.

devops-bot: release-4.0.3 signed by rwd-build-2026 uploaded :package:

rachael_ops: activator flow: customer generates CSR -> delivers via SFTP/USB -> we return time-bound token (defaults 14-30d). Verification runs fully offline.

tom_se: draft blurb: "Redwood can deliver signed, verifiable on-prem bundles for an isolated 30-day POC. We support USB or air-gapped repo distribution, include SPDX SBOMs, and provide a local verification utility that can use customer HSM-exported public keys. Intra-minor delta updates reduce bandwidth; cross-minor upgrades require full bundles. An offline activation flow using time-bound tokens is available; key rotation and emergency revocation processes will be specified in the SOW."

alejandra_sales: PS estimate?

rachael_ops: recommend 3.5d (2d runbook/onboarding, 1d bundle tweaks, 0.5d token ops). If customer wants BYO private signing in our pipeline -> out of scope, requires security review and ~5-10d PS.

alejandra_sales: perfect, sending now. Will loop back if they press on BYO signing. :seedling:
